Application for ITMO exchange semester 2024-2025 
 
ESSENTIAL CONTACTS 
Academic mobility support office Ms. Yulia Shik 
Ms. Darya Pavlichenko 
incoming@itmo.ru  
IMPORTANT DATES 
Nomination deadline Autumn Semester 2024: April 30, 2024  
Spring Semester 2025: September 30, 2024 
  
Application deadline Autumn Semester 2024: June 15, 2024 
Spring Semester 2025: November 15, 2024 
 
   
Academic calendar Fall semester: 
• Study period (including exam period): September 1, 
2024 – January 31, 2025 
• New Year holidays: January 1-8, 2025 
 
Spring semester: 
• Study period (including exam period): 
February 1 – May 31, 2025 
STUDENT ADMISSION REQUIREMENTS 
General Requirements • to be at least a 3rd year Bachelor student or a Master student at home university 
• to have good and excellent academic standing 
 
Language requirements B1 level of English is required  
B2 level is recommended 
The language proficiency shall be confirmed either by an internationally recognized certificate (IELTS, 
ToEFL, Cambridge exams) or the letter of confirmations issued by the English language department of the 
sending university

APPLICATION STEPS 
Nomination Sending university nominates its students for the 
program providing nomination letters and the 
students’ contact details at incoming@itmo.ru  
Autumn semester 2024: January 1 – April 30, 2024 
 
Spring semester 2025: July 1 – September 30, 2024 
 
  
Online application and submission 
of documents 
The students fill out online application form and upload 
the following application documents in the PDF-format at  
https://int.itmo.ru/en/application_for_exchange:   
• Passport (should be valid for at least 18 months) 
• Transcript of records in English 
• English proficiency confirmation (for non -native 
speakers) 
 
Autumn semester 2024: up June 15, 2024 
 
Spring semester 2025: up November 15, 2024 
   
Acceptance confirmation ITMO considers the submitted applications and confirms 
if the students are accepted*    
*online interview may be required 
Within two weeks upon the application 
submission 
   
Invitation procedure ITMO starts the invitation procedure. 
Generally, it takes up to 40 days. When the Invitations are issued, ITMO sends them to the students via e-mails. 
   
Visa application Upon reception of the Invitations, the students should apply for student visas at the home country.  
IMPORTANT: 
• The first entry visa is valid for 90 days 
• Upon arrival in Saint Petersburg, the visas will be extended by ITMO Migration Services Office. The 
students should apply for their visas’ extension at least 45 days before the first visa expiration date  
• Visa extension fee is 1,600 rubles

Upon-arrival procedures Upon arrival, the students should: 
1. Visit ITMO Migration Services Office to obtain the 
migration registration (for the students staying at ITMO 
dormitories) within 3 days upon the arrival 
IMPORTANT: if the students stay at a hotel/hostel or rent 
an apartment, they must get the migration registration 
from the hotel/hostel administration or the apartment’s 
owner and submit the copy to ITMO Migration Services 
Office within 7 days upon arrival. The regis tration is only 
valid if made on the actual address of the 
hotel/hostel/apartment. 
2. Submit the following original documents: 
• Chest X -RAY report if stay at ITMO dormitory 
(could be done upon arrival) 
• 2 PCR tests* 
Each student is provided with Buddy’s assistance.  
* As of today, it`s required due to the situation with COVID-19. 
 
 
 OTHER IMPORTANT INFORMATION 
Accommodation options 1. Student dormitory (shared rooms for 3-4 persons) 
Accommodation fee is 2,000 – 5,000 rubles per one month 
 
2. ITMO partner hotel (single or twin rooms) 
Accommodation fees vary from 18,000 rubles (twin room) to 37,000 rubles (single room) per one month*  
*the fees indicated can be changed

Average monthly living expenses Approximately 20,000 – 25,000 rubles per one month (excluding accommodation fee).
